logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the complexes was determined by the shake flask method using distilled water and n-octanol as the solvent [34]. The n-octanol and distilled water were pre-saturated with each other before use. The complexes were dissolved in the pre-saturated n-octanol. 5 mL of the above solution and the pre-saturated 5 mL of distilled water were added in 15-mL centrifuge tube. The mixture was shaken vigorously for 24 h, and then the organic and water phases were separated. The concentrations of the complexes in each phase were measured by the UV/Vis spectrophotometer. Experiments were performed in triplicate. The partition coefficients P were calculated from the ratio Coct/Cwater, where Coct and Cwater were the concentrations of the complexes in the n-octanol and in the water, respectively. Equilibration and absorption measurements were performed at room temperature.
